children: Vancouver, British Columbia - TheNewswire - Sep 17, 2026 - Wildpack Beverage Inc.

("Wildpack" or the "Company") announces that, effective immediately, all of the directors and all of the officers of the Company have resigned from their respective positions, including Mitch Barnard, Steve Fader, Thomas Walker and Gene Carr. As a result, the Company no longer has any directors or officers.

Further to the Company's news release of July 1, 2026, in which it disclosed that Sandton Capital, the Company's principal secured lender, had advised of its intention to enforce its security, the Company has received notice from Sandton Capital Solutions Master Fund V, LP that it has completed enforcement against the Company's assets. The secured lender had advised that one or more Events of Default have occurred and are continuing under the applicable loan documents, that the indebtedness has been accelerated, and that the total amount owing was $95,351,843.90.

Pursuant to a notice dated Sept 15, 2026, the secured lender has acquired the collateral assets pledged to it in full satisfaction of the indebtedness, pursuant to Section 9-620 of the Uniform Commercial Code. The public company has no remaining assets or operations.

Wildpack provides beverage manufacturing and packaging to the middle market by providing aluminum can filling, decorating, packaging, brokering, and logistics to customers throughout the United States. Wildpack currently operates indirectly through its wholly owned subsidiaries and out of two facilities in Baltimore, Maryland; and Austin, Texas.
